newsitem.title: USA: J.C. Penney sells $2.5 bln in six-part debt deal.
newsitem.headline: J.C. Penney sells $2.5 bln in six-part debt deal.

text.p: The following six-tranche debt deal from J.C. Penney Co Inc was priced on Wednesday via lead manager Credit Suisse First Boston Corp, according to market sources.
The deal was increased several times in size to $2.5 billion from an initial size of $2.0 billion to meet heavy investor demand, sources added.
